wiki.title: Jeremy Trebas
wiki.extract: Jeremy Trebas (born June 3, 1984) is an American politician who is serving in the Montana Senate from the 10th district since 2025 and previously in the 13th district from 2023 to 2025 and in the Montana House of Representatives from the 26th district from 2021 to 2023 and previously in the 25th district from 2017 to 2019.
